description: This file contains unit tests for the PayGradeService class in the OrangeHRM project. It verifies various functionalities such as retrieving pay grade data, currency lists, pay periods, saving and deleting pay grade data, and obtaining allowed currencies, focusing on the service layer interactions with the DAO and entity classes.

classes.name: PayGradeServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing PayGradeService functionalities, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and auxiliary methods related to pay grades and currencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data before each test method.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeDao
methods.description: Verifies that getPayGradeDao() returns an instance of PayGradeDao.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of pay grades via the service layer.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific pay grade by its ID.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieving currency list associated with a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests retrieving a specific currency for a pay grade by currency and pay grade IDs.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriodArray
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of pay periods formatted as an array.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeArray
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of pay grades formatted as an array.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyArray
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of currencies formatted as an array.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Verifies count of pay grade currency list.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of pay grade currency list based on search filters.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Tests saving a new pay grade.

methods.name: testSavePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Tests saving a pay grade currency entity.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Tests deletion of pay grades by IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of allowed pay currencies based on filters.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Verifies count of allowed pay currencies based on filters.
